grammar.he.ANI_FUTURE.why: With אני the future tense starts with א.
grammar.he.ET_IM.why: This verb takes עם (“with”), not a direct object with את.
grammar.he.HACHI_BEYOTER.why: הכי and ביותר both mean “most”: one is enough.
grammar.he.NUM_GENDER.why: From three to ten the number has the form that looks like the other gender: שלושה ילדים, שלוש בנות.
grammar.he.PLEONASM.why: The extra word repeats what the other one already says.
grammar.he.REGISTER_BIGLAL.why: בגלל ש is spoken Hebrew; formal texts use מכיוון ש or משום ש.
grammar.he.REGISTER_HACHI.why: הכי is spoken Hebrew; formal texts use ביותר.
grammar.he.SMICHUT_DEF.why: In a construct pair the article goes on the last noun.
grammar.he.TWO_GENDER.why: Before a noun two is שני (masculine) or שתי (feminine); שניים and שתיים stand alone.
